0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Nets host the Hornets, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Brooklyn a 40% chance to win. The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2 to Charlotte, including a 117-86 defeat in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder injury, while six Hornets are day-to-day with game-time decisions: Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Grayson Allen (knee soreness), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Kylan Boswell (knee), and Moussa Diabate (elbow).
